text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Timur) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 26 Januari 2026.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Timur

yang bermula dari—

(a) kilometer 0.00 di koordinat U -73360.788, T 34660.310 Geosentrik

Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 16.78

di koordinat U -58391.875, T 33186.605 Geosentrik Datum

Malaysia (GDM2000), termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat

Sungai Long, Plaza Tol Sungai Long, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Bandar Mahkota Cheras, Plaza Tol Bandar Mahkota Cheras,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Hulu Langat, Plaza Tol Hulu Langat,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ampang, Plaza Tol Ampang dan jalan

sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 16.78 kilometer; dan

(b) kilometer 0.00 Jalan Spur di koordinat U -53582.172, T 28526.241

Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer

3.04 Jalan Spur di koordinat U -52240.461, T 30764.039 Geosentrik

Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) termasuk Jalan Ukay Perdana,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kg. Pasir dan jalan sambungannya, iaitu

suatu jarak sepanjang 3.04 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Timur) 2025

[P.U. (A) 317/2025] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA LEMBAH KLANG TIMUR

Dibuat 21 Januari 2026

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Klang Valley

Expressway) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 26 January 2026.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the East Klang Valley Expressway

commencing from—

(a) kilometre 0.00 at coordinates N -73360.788, E 34660.310

of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) and ending

at kilometre 16.78 at coordinates N -58391.875, E 33186.605

of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000), including

the Sungai Long Interchange, Sungai Long Toll Plaza,

Bandar Mahkota Cheras Interchange, Bandar Mahkota Cheras

Toll Plaza, Hulu Langat Interchange, Hulu Langat Toll Plaza,

Ampang Interchange, Ampang Toll Plaza and its link roads,

being a distance of 16.78 kilometre; and

(b) kilometre 0.00 Spur Road at coordinates N -53582.172,

E 28526.241 of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000)

and ending at kilometre 3.04 Spur Road at coordinates

N -52240.461, E 30764.039 of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000) including the Ukay Perdana Road, Kg. Pasir Interchange

and its link road, being a distance of 3.04 kilometre,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (East Klang Valley Expressway) Order 2025

[P.U. (A) 317/2025] is revoked.

SCHEDULE
